summary: Pass at b6326503, the current HEAD. Review C found no blocking finding. The six week manifests and the cover manifest let Workbooks find each file, its row, its size class, and its line-art twin. Every hash agrees with the person-review records. The person-review records and the plan give each week and the cover a PASS record, and no delivered manifest holds a person review. The contact sheets exist with 3 sheets for each week. Five nonblocking nits remain. contract.md documents neither deliver-cover nor cover-calm-top. The cover job fields are undocumented placeholders. The contract ready rule is stale for the Muse path. cover-calm-top uses exit code 1 for two different results. The cover status text differs a little from the week text.
nonblocking_findings: RC-P4-1 [Nit] review-c: measure/tracks/asset_storytime_l2_unit1_pictures_20261025/contract.md:43-107 (Commands) holds a deliver entry (lines 71-99, the RC-P3-1 fix) but no entry for deliver-cover or cover-calm-top. The CLI accepts both commands (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:4654-4657) and runs them (cover-calm-top at about :4753-4759, deliver-cover at about :4791-4809). An operator who reads contract.md cannot learn the flags (--approvals, --muse, --delivery; --print), the one-entry cover approval list, the output lines, or the exit codes. Remediation: add a contract.md entry for each command in the form of the deliver entry. Owner: Green.

RC-P4-2 [Nit] review-c: the cover job has week 1, bookKind readalong, use cover, size cover, and directory cover (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts coverJob, about :550-567; out/storytime/l2/unit1/cover/delivery-muse-v1/manifest.json). The batch cover/color also has week 1 and bookKind readalong. These fields are the same as the fields of the week 1 reader covers l2-w01-cover-hello and l2-w01-cover-nan-can-nod; only the id and the directory are different. The candidate has no lineArt. contract.md:115-126 and :318-333 do not document the Level 2 cover job, so a consumer that groups by week and bookKind can put the Level 2 cover into the week 1 read-along book. A consumer that matches by row id (decision A, contract.md:28-30) finds no list row for l2-cover-v1. Remediation: add a contract.md note that week and bookKind are placeholders for the cover, that the id l2-cover-v1 and the directory cover identify the Level 2 cover, and that the cover has no line-art twin; do not deliver again. Owner: Green.

RC-P4-3 [Nit] review-c: contract.md:320-324 still says that a color candidate is ready only when both model logs and its person log pass, and no 'Replaced by the amendment of 2026-11-01' line follows it. The Muse writer sets status ready for each delivered job (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:428, :437, :603). All 162 week 2 to 7 jobs and the cover job have reviews {}, as spec.md:193 ('Only clean rows go into the manifest') and spec.md:200-202 require. A Workbooks reader of contract.md can read ready as person-checked. The person record lives only in measure/runs/person-review-*.json and plan.md. Remediation: add the replaced line and a Muse-path meaning of ready to contract.md:318-333. Owner: Green.

RC-P4-4 [Nit] review-c: cover-calm-top returns 1 when the share is above 0.02 (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:about 4758). It also exits 1 when the print cannot be read or has other than 3 channels, because coverCalmTopReport throws (book-pictures.ts:about 1388-1393) and the entry returns 1 (scripts/storytime-book-pictures.ts:48-55). A script cannot tell a failed gate C1 from a failed tool by the exit code. The stage check uses 0, 1, and 2 for this purpose. Remediation: document the shared exit code in the RC-P4-1 entry, or return 2 for an input error. Owner: Green.

RC-P4-5 [Nit] review-c: plan.md:4314-4315 changes the cover from 'awaiting person review' to 'person review PASS'. The weeks use 'delivered, awaiting person review' and 'delivered, person review PASS' (plan.md:4054-4055, :4079-4080), and test-strategy.md:2260 (A6) uses 'delivered, awaiting person review'. The cover was delivered (plan.md:4289-4290), so the cover text omits the word 'delivered'. The facts agree; only the status text differs. Remediation: use 'delivered, person review PASS' for the cover in the Phase 5 registry and metadata text. Owner: Green.
